d:
Want to suggest a guest?
I’m back after a month away, and this one is just me, no guest. I got married, moved out of Bombay, and spent the gap reading instead of recording. So I sat down and answered everything you have been asking: how I met my wife, why I kept it private, the scam that is the Indian wedding industry, growing older, wasted potential, and my honest take on the politics everyone keeps dragging me into. Half of this is me talking to myself as much as to you. It feels good to be back.

Vinamre Kasanaa is a writer at heart, podcaster and entrepreneur by craft.
